findings.issue: Hiphil sequential 3mp: they brought him out. «sacó» is 3s.
אֶל־מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה is to the outside of the camp. «al campamento» can be read as destination to the camp; the min in מִחוּץ is unexpressed.

notes: Apedrearon con las piedras, murió, Jehová, and Moisés match the other tokens.
